result.note: Art and culture restitution item; tested the plates' contents, their custodian and the restitution timeline.

questions.prompt: In May 2026, the Netherlands returned the Anaimangalam Copper Plates of the Chola dynasty to India. Consider the following statements about these plates:
items: They had been held at Leiden University since the mid-19th century.
They record grants by Chola emperor Rajaraja I to a Buddhist monastery at Mamallapuram.
India had pursued their restitution since 2012.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 2 is wrong because the monastery was at the port town of Nagapattinam in Tamil Nadu, not Mamallapuram. The 11th-century set of 21 large and three small sheets was handed back during Prime Minister Modi's visit to the Netherlands.
questions.source: record grants by Chola emperor Rajaraja I to a Buddhist monastery at the port town of Nagapattinam in Tamil Nadu.
